events.title: 🔑 The Transference Demo Is Now Available for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: 🔑 The Transference demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest!Dive into this first-person mystery thriller and take your first steps into a house full of puzzles, secrets, and unsettling inhabitants.Explore your boarded-up home, decipher riddles inspired by Spanish culture, and piece together a story of family secrets and betrayal. But remember: you're not alone. Observe your surroundings, find somewhere to hide, and uncover who locked you in... and why.

events.title: New 60FPS Steam Deck Compatible Version
events.summary: New puzzles (the final ones).Optimisation for graphics cards of the order of 1000 GTX and STEAM DECK at a stable 60 FPS.Added English dubbing.

events.title: The Transference DEMO at Steam Scream Fest
events.summary: I'm happy to announce that The Transference DEMO will be available during Steam Scream Fest (October 28th to November 4th). In fact, you can download it right now! ːsteamhappyː Don't miss the chance to try out the new demo version. Since after the event... it will disappear! ːsteammockingː https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GamEnyiWYAARbia?format=jpg&name=large

events.title: Steam page updated!
events.summary: The contents of the Steam page have been updated, adding screenshots of the new areas of the game. In addition, the Steam page teaser has also been updated. Stay tuned! At the end of this month the new demo will be made public.

events.summary: Bugs fixed There were some walls that the character could walk through and go out of the stage. The interactable area with one of the items has been extended. If the player died and did not get the letter document, it could now be get never. The textures of the basement monitors had disappeared with the last update. events.title: The Transference Patch Notes (v0.3.009)
events.summary: Bugs Fixed Some AMD graphics cards had problems with Ray Tracing enabled. Some controllers can't move to up and left in some menus. Updated some document titles. Updated Discord URL. Fixed a cinematic. Changes some lights. Changed some zones' interactable mark. Corrected a subtitle.

events.title: The Transference Patch Notes (v0.3.006)
events.summary: Bugs Fixed Fixed a bug that occurred when interacting with the Settings menu, which could set some fields such as ‘Voices’ and ‘Subtitles’ without visible values. Fixed a bug for controllers that prevented correct navigation of the pause menu. New features Added a new ‘Brightness’ field in the Settings menu. Improved navigation of the Settings menu options.
